M&TBank ASSIGNMENTANDSUBORDINATIONOFMASTERLEASE THIS ASSIGNMENT AND SUBORDINATION OF MASTER LEASE (this "Agreement") made as of July 16, 2025 by 577 RETAIL LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address c/o Benjamin Partners, 589 Broadway, 4th Floor, New York, New company, having an address c/o Benjamin Partners, 589 Broadway, 4th Floor, New York, New York 10012 ("Borrower"), to MANUFACTURERS AND TRADERS TRUST COMPANY, a NewYork banking corporation,having an office c/o M&T Bank, 277Park Avenue,NewYork, New York 10172, as lender (together with its successors and assigns, “Lender"). Borrower has requested that Lender make a loan toBorrower in the amount of $24,000,000.00 (the “Loan"). The Loan shall be (i) governed by a Loan Agreement dated of even date herewith (as the same may be amended,modified, extended, supplemented, restated or replaced from time to time, the “Loan Agreement") made by and among Borrower and Lender, (i) evidenced by that certain Consolidated, Modified, Extended and Restated Mortgage Note dated of even date herewith in the principal amount of $24,000,000.00 made by and between Borrower and Lender (as the same may be amended, modified, extended, supplemented, split, severed, restated or replaced from time to time, the “Note"), and (ii) secured by, among other things, that certain Mortgage Consolidation, Modification, Extension and Restatement Agreement dated of even date herewith made by and between Borrower and Lender (as the same may be amended,modified, extended, split, severed, renewed or restated from time to time, the “Security Instrument";together with the Loan Agreement, the Note,and the other documents executed and/or delivered in connection with the Loan, as the same may be amended or otherwise modified from time to time, the “Loan Documents"), encumbering the premises known as and located at 577 Broadway (a/k/a 148 Mercer Street), New York, New York.eO C&13C(25 n 2202506020145 Borrower leased a portion of the Premises (hereinafter defined) to Master Tenant pursuant to that certain Net Lease Agreement entered into by Borrower, as landlord, and Master Tenant, as tenant, dated June 12, 2006, as the same may have been modified, amended and/or assigned from time to time (collectively, the “Master Lease"). Master Tenant is an Affiliate of Borrower and, therefore,has a financial interest in Borrower obtaining the Loan. All capitalized termsusedbutnotseparatelydefined hereinshall havethemeanings ascribed to them in the Loan Agreement. thereon)moreparticularlydescribed inExhibit Aattached hereto(hereinafter called the "Premises"); (b) all rents, rent equivalents, moneys payable as damages (including payments by reason of the rejection ofa Lease in a bankruptcy action) or in lieu of rent equivalents, additional rents,revenues,issues and profits,income,fees,receivables,deposits (including,without limitation,security,utilityandother deposits),accounts and receiptspayablepursuant to anyLease or otherwisefromPremiseswhetherpaid or accruingbefore or after thefilingbyor againstMaster Tenant of any petition for relief under the 11 U.s.C. 101 et seq.,as the same may be amended from time to time (the“Bankruptcy Code"),including all claims and rights to the payment of damages arising from any rejection by a lessee of any Lease under the Bankruptcy Code (collectively, the “Rents"); (c) all of Master Tenant's right, title and interest in and claims under any and all lease guaranties, letters of credit and any other credit support (a “Lease Guaranty") given by any Person in connection with any of the Leases; (d) all proceeds from the sale or other disposition of the Leases, the Rents, and the Lease Guaranties; (e) all rights, powers, privileges, options and otherbenefits of Master Tenant as sublessor under the Leases and beneficiary under the Lease Guaranties, including, without limitation, the immediate and continuing right to make claimfor,receiveandcollect all Rents payable orreceivable underthe Leases and all sumspayable under the Lease Guaranties or pursuant thereto (and to apply the same to the payment of the Debt), and to do all other things which Master Tenant or any lessor or sublessor is or may become entitled to do under the Leases or the Lease Guaranties; and (f) any and all other rights of Master Tenant in and to the items set forth in clauses (a) through (e) above, and all amendments, modifications, replacements,renewalsand substitutions thereof. Theagreements contained herein constitute a present andirrevocable assignment and are made for the purpose of securing (i) Borrower's full payment of all principal, interest, indebtedness and other sums now or hereafter due under theNote,whichNote is also secured by theSecurityInstrument,togetherwith any other sums (togetherwith interest thereon)becoming due and payable to Lender under any other Loan Documents and (i) Master Tenant's full performance and discharge of each and every obligation, covenant, representation, warranty and agreement of MasterTenant under thisAgreement. THIS AGREEMENT is made on the following terms, provisions, covenants and conditions: 1. IncorporationByReference.The Loan Agreement contains certain provisions constituting an agreement restricting Master Tenant's powers, as against Lender without its consent, to abridge or otherwise modify tenancies,subtenancies or Leases of the Premises or to accept prepayments of installments of rent to become due thereunder, all of which provisions are incorporated herein with the same force and with like effect as ifthey were fully set forth herein at length and made a part hereof. 2. Subordination.EachofMasterTenant andBorrower agrees that theMaster Lease and all of the terms, covenants and provisions thereof, and all estates, options and rights created undertheMasterLease,hereby are subordinated and madesubject to the terms,provisions and lien of the Loan Documents and the Security Instrument (including,without limitation, all renewals,increases,modifications, spreaders,consolidations, replacements and extensions thereof),as if the Loan Documents and the Security Instrument had been executed and/or recorded prior to the Master Lease. -2- ACTIVE711598011v5

No OtherAssignments.MasterTenanthereby covenants andwarrants to Lender that Master Tenant has not executed any prior assignment of the Leases or Rents which shall be effective after the date hereof,other than toLender,nor hasMaster Tenant performed any act orexecuted any otherinstrumentwhichmight prevent Lenderfromoperatingunder any of the terms,provisions, covenants and conditions of this Agreement or which would limit Lender in suchoperation. 4. Status of Leases.Rents.Master Tenant covenants andwarrants toLender that MasterTenant has not executed orgranted anymodificationwhatsoever of theLeases,except as herein indicated,or as otherwise disclosed byBorrower in any other Loan Document,and that the Leases are in full force and effect, and that, to Master Tenant's knowledge, there are no defaults now existing under the Leases.Any abridgement or modification of any tenancy, subtenancy or Leases or any prepayment of any installment of rent more than one (1) month in advance without the consent of Lendermaybevoidable as against Lender. 5. RevocableLicenseforPossession of Leases and Collectionof Rents.So long as there shall exist no Event of Default, Master Tenant shall have the right, and is hereby granted a revocable license by Lender, to retain possession of the Leases and to exercise all rights afforded to the sublandlord under the Leases, including the right to collect at the time of, but not for more than one (1) month prior to, the date provided for the payment thereof, all Rents, and to retain,use and enjoy thesame.MasterTenant,without the priorconsentofLender,shall notcause or permit the sub-leasehold estate under the Leases to merge with Master Tenant's reversionary interest. 6. RemediesUponEventofDefault.Upon theoccurrenceandduringthe continuance of an Event of Default,Lender,without in any way waiving such default, at Lender's option,without notice andwithout regard to the adequacy of the securityfor theDebt,either in person or by agent, with or without bringing any action or proceeding, or by a receiver appointed by a court, may take possession of the Premises (or any portion thereof) and have, hold, manage, lease and operate the same on such terms andfor such period oftime as Lender may deem proper.
